card.name: Start of long prefixed science words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long word split after a prefix, such as hyp, kil, meg, gig, intr or MIC, just before the rest of the word (omotility, owatts, acytoplasmic, amuscular, avenously, ROWAVE).
